scores.evidence: Objectives are unchanged, and in check-quiz only q4-d changed: q4 still assesses o3 (understand) with key b 「ファイルはできたが、サーバーにはまだない」, and q6 (o1, b), q5 (o2, b) and q3 (o3, c) are untouched, so every objective is still assessed.

hook-b1 is unchanged. In q0 the options were lengthened, not changed in meaning: c 「AIが、入力されたタスクを覚えていないから」 still voices the beginner belief its feedback corrects, and the key b 「データを保存する仕組みが、アプリにないから」 now also matches the feedback's 「アプリの仕組みです」.

The コミット definition in s4-b2 and the glossary now reads 「その時点のファイル全体の状態を、変更の説明（メッセージ）と一緒に、Gitに記録することです。」, identical in both places, still after s4-analogy (「1回ごとのセーブがコミット」), and consistent with s4-prompt-commit's 「Gitにコミットしてください」. The other analogies and definitions are unchanged.

validate and lint --strict are clean; s3-b2 step 1 lost 「まず、」 (now 23 characters) and q4-d gained 「アプリが」 (26 characters), with no new term or sentence. 1-2 remains the crowded segment it was (UI, API and JSON, an analogy, a tip, JSON code, two prompts and q2), so the score stays at 3.

ex-steps is unchanged; q9 still fades step ④ onto 期限, and option a now reads 「一覧の各タスクに期限の日付を表示して。APIとデータベースは変えないで」, matching its English "in the list", so the faded step keeps the same contrast with the key b 「期限を保存し、一覧のAPIでも返して。画面はまだ変えないで」.

Every content section still has its inline check with feedback on every wrong option, and the exam is unchanged apart from q4-d. In q4 the key b (20 characters) does not stand out: a is 20, c 19, and the changed distractor d 「アプリがサーバーで起動して、もう依頼を待ち受けている」 is now the longest (26), so the padding went into a distractor, not the key.

q4-d now names the stage the learner skips in the lesson's own words: 「アプリがサーバーで起動して、もう依頼を待ち受けている」 maps onto s3-b2's 「起動：サーバーで、届いた依頼に答えられる状態にします。」, so it voices the misconception 'a finished build is already live', and its unchanged feedback 「依頼を待ち受けるのは、サーバーに送って起動したあとです。」 (en "after the files are sent and the app is launched") now matches the option exactly. The other distractors are unchanged.

s1-b2 is unchanged (4 nodes, labels matching the terms, takeaway caption and alt), and the deploy stages stay a numbered list in s3-b2 (ビルド・転送・起動); the only change there is step 1 now reading 「ビルド：公開するためのファイル一式を作ります。」, the list order carrying the sequence.

pc-input now reads 「画面側の依頼に、読み終えた日の入力とAPIでの保存が書いてあります」, the same criterion as before and still checkable against practice-answer-ui; the transfer task, expects and model answers are unchanged. The hint ladder is still two levels (hint → troubleshoot), not the three of anchor 4.

summary-points (4) comes after the exam, summary-next asks a reflection question (「UIとAPIのどちらの変更か考えてみましょう」) and names the next step (第2章), and summary-ask offers tutor prompts. cards has 7 retrieval cards, and the changed fronts match the text (「デプロイの3つの段階は？」 as in s3-flow).

s3-b2 step 1 no longer asserts build-first (「まず、」 removed), which now agrees with s3-flow's softened wording and mdn-publishing (some hosts build on their side); the step stays within mdn-deployment. q4-d's claim that a local build does not mean the app 「サーバーで起動」 matches mdn-deployment and mdn-server-side as cited. No menu, button or shortcut is introduced.

です・ます and the warm tone are kept and lint is clean; s3-b2 step 1 keeps the 「段階：…します。」 pattern of steps 2 and 3, and q4-d stays a plain-form option fragment like a–c. Still left for the ja-editor: hook-b1's 「頼むと、画面はすぐにできました」, q1-b's causative 「保存させる」, and 1-5's データ側/画面側 beside フロントエンド and UI.

Both changed fields keep jp and en and agree: q4-d "The app has been launched on the server and is already waiting for requests" matches 「アプリがサーバーで起動して、もう依頼を待ち受けている」, and s3-b2 step 1's unchanged English "Build: make the set of files for publishing." matches 「公開するためのファイル一式を作ります」. Only s2-prompt-api's English keeps quotes the Japanese dropped (niceToHave of round 4, still open).

niceToHave: check-quiz q4-d: at 26 characters, 「アプリがサーバーで起動して、もう依頼を待ち受けている」 is now the longest option in q4 and may wrap on a phone, where round 4 fixed line breaks; check it in the next mobile preview (visual-qa). If it wraps badly, 「アプリがサーバーで起動し、依頼を待っている」 keeps the meaning (en: "The app has been launched on the server and is waiting for requests").

s3-b2 step 1 now says 「公開するための」 while vibe-def-build, the glossary, q4-c/d feedback and the card say 「公開用」; the meaning is the same and either reads well, so this is for the ja-editor to keep or align.

s2-prompt-api (unchanged, carried from round 4): the English still reads "Add \"{{field to add}}\" to the API…" with quotes the Japanese dropped; to match the Japanese and s2-prompt-ui's English: "Add {{field to add}} to the API that returns the task list. If the database has nowhere to store it, add that too. Keep the existing fields as they are, and do not change how the screen looks."
summary: Verification round (review-scope.mjs exit 0: 2 of 94 parts changed, 3%, sections and objectives unchanged; previous review 72c9e87, lessonHash sha256:0bc11122003d247c). validate and lint --strict are clean. The previous round had no open must-fix items, so nothing needed resolving. Both changed blocks were reviewed in full. s3-b2 step 1 drops 「まず、」 and now agrees with s3-flow and mdn-publishing. q4-d now says the app is launched on the server, which uses the 起動 stage's own wording, matches its unchanged feedback, and keeps the key b from standing out. No new must-fix and no regression; scores are unchanged (mean 3.77). Small notes: q4-d's length on mobile, 公開するため vs 公開用, and the carried-over English quotes in s2-prompt-api.
